name: complexity-lens-vscode
description: Cyclomatic complexity on hover, a jump to the covering test, and mutation testing of one test case

commands.title: Run Mutation Testing on This Test

complexityLens.hover.enabled.description: Show the cyclomatic complexity of a function when you hover over it.

complexityLens.complexity.moderateThresh.description: The count where a function stops being simple.

complexityLens.complexity.complexThresho.description: The count where a function becomes complex.

complexityLens.complexity.criticalThresh.description: The count where a function becomes critical.

complexityLens.testLookup.mutationReport.description: Mutation reports to read, relative to the workspace folder. A mutation report names the tests that cover a line exactly.

complexityLens.testLookup.coveragePaths.description: Line coverage reports to read, relative to the workspace folder. They tell you whether a line is covered at all.

complexityLens.testLookup.useReferences.description: Ask the TypeScript language server of VS Code for the callers of the function, and keep the callers that sit in a test file.

complexityLens.mutation.testRunner.description: The test runner that runs one test case. `auto` reads the nearest package.json.

complexityLens.mutation.reportDirectory.description: Where Stryker writes its report, relative to the workspace folder.

complexityLens.mutation.commandTemplate.description: The whole mutation command. Leave it empty to use the built-in Stryker command. The placeholders are ${testCommand}, ${testFile}, ${testName}, ${testNamePattern}, ${mutate}, ${reportDirectory} and ${workspaceFolder}.

complexityLens.mutation.concurrency.description: The number of parallel Stryker workers. 0 leaves the choice to Stryker.

complexityLens.mutation.namePatternScope.description: `full` puts the titles of the enclosing suites into the name filter. `leaf` uses the title of the test case alone.

complexityLens.mutation.confirmBeforeRun.description: Show the command line and ask before the mutation run starts.

complexityLens.mutation.markSurvivors.description: Mark every surviving mutant in the editor after the run.
